data_source: synthetic; no industrial CAM data has been supplied
split_design: Distinct corner sequences, notch layout, segment counts and line/curve primitive composition. No rotation or uniform scaling copies across splits.
test_policy: Algorithm performance on the held-out split is evaluated only after final model/configuration freeze. Any use for model selection converts those data into development data.
coordinates: XY positions in mm; timestamps in seconds; angles in radians
cam_discretization_error: Zero for defining polylines; at most 0.005 mm analytic-curve-to-polyline deviation for sampled cubic Bezier primitives; independent of planner tolerance.
planner_tolerance: environment.epsilon is full band width. Independent one-sided geometric tolerance is epsilon/2, without silently adding CAM discretization error.
ordered_coverage: Reference witnesses retain all vertices; default spacing min(0.25mm, one-sided tolerance/2). Match within one-sided tolerance minus spacing/2, in monotonic execution order. This conservative order certificate is not an exact continuous Frechet solver.
kinematics: Compute backward differences from timestamps and position commands aligned at the interval endpoint. Initial derivatives must be explicitly supplied or excluded as unknown. Scalar feed, heading and Cartesian-axis derivatives are reported separately.
failure_policy: Retain all incomplete, timeout, stall, geometry and motion-constraint failures. Timing statistics identify successful seed/path pairs explicitly.
statistical_unit: Independent training seed and path, never interpolation points. Main claims require at least five independent training seeds per selected learning configuration.
